message.content: {"note_claim": "The image is from an E-3 Sentry accident at Nellis AFB in 2009, not connected to the Iranian attack on Prince Sultan Air Base on 27 March 2026.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "A Boeing E-3C Sentry operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) sustained substantial damage in a landing accident at Las Vegas-Nellis AFB, NV (LSV).", "reason": "The page documents a 28 August 2009 E-3C landing accident at Nellis AFB with a fire, substantiating the note's claim about the 2009 Nellis E-3 incident, though it does not itself show the image."}

parsed.note_claim: The image is from an E-3 Sentry accident at Nellis AFB in 2009, not connected to the Iranian attack on Prince Sultan Air Base on 27 March 2026.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: A Boeing E-3C Sentry operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) sustained substantial damage in a landing accident at Las Vegas-Nellis AFB, NV (LSV).
